title: Board-Up, Roof Tarp and Temporary Fencing Price List (Fire & Smoke Mitigation)
content:
Fire & Smoke Mitigation securing work closes an open structure after a fire: plywood board-up, roof tarping and temporary security fencing. This price list states, tier by tier, whether securing is part of the tier, the unit price of each securing item, and whether board-up already installed stays billable when the dispatch is cancelled before the cleaning authorization is signed.

## Items

- Board-up permitted: Whether emergency board-up and tarping are part of the tier, boolean.
- Plywood board-up: Emergency board-up per 4x8 plywood sheet installed, USD.
- Roof tarp: Emergency roof tarp installed per square foot, USD.
- Temporary fencing: Temporary security fencing per linear foot per placement, USD.
- Board-up billable on cancellation: Whether board-up already installed stays billable when the job is cancelled before authorization of cleaning, boolean.

## Prices by tier

| Tier | Board-up permitted | Plywood, per sheet (USD) | Roof tarp, per sq ft (USD) | Fencing, per linear ft per placement (USD) | Board-up billable on cancellation |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Smoke Odor Response | No | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | No |
| Light Smoke and Soot Cleanup | No | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | No |
| Moderate Fire and Smoke Cleanup | Yes | 68.40 | 1.38 | 0.00 | Yes |
| Heavy Fire Cleanup | Yes | 68.40 | 1.38 | 4.85 | Yes |
| Structural Fire Large Loss | Yes | 61.55 | 1.24 | 4.36 | Yes |
| Commercial Fire Large Loss | Yes | 61.55 | 1.24 | 4.36 | Yes |

## Points of reading

- On Smoke Odor Response and Light Smoke and Soot Cleanup board-up and tarping are not part of the tier, and every securing price on those rows is 0.00.
- Moderate Fire and Smoke Cleanup includes board-up and tarping but prices temporary fencing at 0.00.
- Heavy Fire Cleanup carries the full securing price list at 68.40 per sheet, 1.38 per square foot of tarp and 4.85 per linear foot of fencing; the two Large Loss tiers carry lower unit prices of 61.55, 1.24 and 4.36.
- Fencing is priced per linear foot for each placement; board-up per 4x8 sheet; tarp per square foot installed.

## Illustration of a line (hypothetical quantities)

On a hypothetical Structural Fire Large Loss job where 10 sheets of plywood are installed, the line is 10 sheets at 61.55 each, which is 615.50. A hypothetical 200 square feet of roof tarp on the same tier is 200 at 1.24 each, which is 248.00.
